fullHistory.content:
Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co-pilot for the Unitree G1. Here's what we can do together:

🤖 Poses
"Make the robot stand in a relaxed pose."
"Show the robot waving its right arm."
"Put the robot in a T‑pose for calibration."

✋ Hands
"Close the left hand into a fist."
"Open the right hand and point forward."
"Make both hands clap together."

🎬 Simulation
"Simulate the robot walking forward across the room."
"Run a balancing demo where it shifts weight onto one leg."
"Create a simple sit‑down and stand‑up motion."

⌨️ Code & Controls
"Add keyboard shortcuts to trigger walking and waving."
"Expose a UI slider to control the robot’s waist rotation."
"Implement a script that makes the robot follow a moving target."
